preconditions.expression: T == int(stdin.split()[0]) and T >= 1 and T <= 1000
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 1000) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(N == int(line.split()[0]) and N >= 2 and N <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:2*T+1:2])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line after T is an integer N (2 ≤ N ≤ 10^5) representing the number of businesses.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == N - 1 for edges in [stdin.splitlines()[2*T + i:2*T + i + N - 1] for i in range(0, 2*T, 2)])
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly N-1 lines describing roads (undirected edges) between businesses, forming a connected graph.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(x) <= N for x in line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2*T:2*T + sum(int(stdin.split()[1 + 2*i]) for i in range(T))])
preconditions.description: Each road is represented by two integers a and b (1 ≤ a, b ≤ N) indicating connected businesses.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2*T + sum(int(stdin.split()[1 + 2*i]) for i in range(T)):2*T + sum(int(stdin.split()[1 + 2*i]) for i in range(T)) + T])
preconditions.description: The last line of each test case contains N space-separated positive integers A_i (1 ≤ A_i ≤ 10^9) representing business values.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly one integer per test case, in the same order as input.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.split()[i] == str(max_damage) for i, max_damage in enumerate(compute_max_damage(stdin)))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is the maximum possible damage achievable by destroying exactly one business. The damage is computed as the sum of GCDs of values in each connected component after removing the business and its incident edges.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(max_damage, int) and max_damage >= 0 for max_damage in compute_max_damage(stdin))
postconditions.description: The computed maximum damage for each test case is a non-negative integer.
